title: Missed-Visit Deposit in Site-Change Estimates by No-Show History
content:
The missed-visit deposit in the site-change estimate for an Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or an Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization moved to another site (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) follows the no-show fees assessed on the patient's In-Person Appointments in the 12 months before the handling date. A fee later waived still counts as assessed.

| No-show fees assessed in those 12 months | Missed-visit deposit added to the estimate |
|---|---|
| two or more | the no-show fee of the booked study's visit type |
| exactly one | the late-cancellation fee of the booked study's visit type |
| none | nothing |

## Records read

- The patient's In-Person Appointments fee history: each no-show fee assessed on any of the patient's appointments, dated within the 12 months before the handling date, whether or not it was later waived.
- The visit type of the study booked against the authorization, whose no-show fee and late-cancellation fee are the fee amounts of that visit type under In-Person Appointments.

## Illustrations (hypothetical histories)

- One no-show fee assessed eight months ago and waived the following week: exactly one fee counts, so the deposit is the late-cancellation fee of the booked study's visit type.
- Two no-show fees assessed in the past year and a third assessed fourteen months ago: two fall inside the 12 months, so the deposit is the no-show fee of the booked study's visit type.
- Late-cancellation fees only, no no-show fee: no no-show fee is counted, so the deposit is nothing.
